uniform_chain_scope: A positive rank-one product-projector perturbation of the actual Gibbs operator; no zero-temperature gap or ground-vector oracle is assumed in the bound. This is an obstruction to an HS-only guarantee, not an impossibility result for structured algorithms.
low_temperature_premise: Tail and ground projector acquired exactly from the physical spin-two dimer spectrum, not transferred to the uniform chain.
limitation: The actual uniform-chain long-ring Gibbs MPO and its certified HS tail have not been acquired.
